Short title and commencement

ACT LVII OF 1975
ACT LVII OF 1975
NATIONAL GUARDS
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 1975
An act to amend
the National Guards Act, 1973
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 26th July 1975]
The following Act of Parliament
received the assent of the President on the 21st July 1975, and is hereby
published for general information :-
1. Short title and
commencement.-(1) This Act may be called the National Guards (Amendment)
Act, 1975.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on the twelfth day of August,
1973.

Amendment of section 1, Act LXI of 1973

[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 26th July 1975]
The following Act of Parliament
received the assent of the President on the 21st July 1975, and is hereby
published for general information :-
2. Amendment of section 1, Act
LXI of 1973.-In the National Guards Act, 1973 (LXI of 1973), hereinafter
referred to as the said Act, in section 1, for subsection (3) the following
shall be substituted, namely:-
"(3) It shall come into
force at once :
Provided that nothing in this Act
shall be deemed to authorize the punish ment of any person for any act or
omission which was not punishable before the 24th day of December, 1973.".

Substitution of section 28, Act LXI of 1973

3. Substitution of section 28,
Act LXI of 1973.---In the said Act, for section 28 the following shall be
substituted, namely:-
"28. Training.-Such
training, including yearly camps, shall be imparted to the college students and
members of the college staff selected for training as may be laid down by the
prescribed officer from time to time.".

4. Amendment of section 29,
Act LXI of 1973.----In the said Act, in section 29,-
(a) for the words and comma
"On successful completion of training a person" the words and commas
"A person who has either successfully com pleted the training or, having
successfully completed not less than seventy-five filer cent. of the total
training periods, is still undergoing training" shall be substituted ; and
(b) for clause (c) the following
shall be substituted, namely :-
"(c) he shall, for the
purpose of admission to any institution of advanced studies, be awarded twenty
marks in addition to the marks obtained by him in the examination held for the
purpose of such admission or, if no such examination is held, in the
examination on the basis of having qualified in ,which he seeks such admission:
Provided that, in respect of the
period preceding the enactment of the National Guards (Amendment) Act, 1975,
this section shall have effect as if for the words "seventy-five per
cent." therein the words "fifty per cent." were
substituted.".

8. Insertion of new section
40-A, Act LXI of 1973.----In the said Act, after section 40 amended a3
aforesaid, the following new section shall be inserted, namely:-
"40-A. Rules and
regulations to have retrospective effect.-Any rule or regulation made
before the enactment of the National Guards (Amendment) Act, 1975, shall be
deemed to have been validly made and taken effect on the twelfth day of August,
1973 and any rule or regulation made within thirty days of such enactment may
be made so as to have retrospective effect from :any day not earlier than that
day.".

9. Validation.-----Notwithstanding
any judgment of any Court, any train ing or certificate provided for in the
National Guards Act, 1973 (LXI of 1973), which may have been imparted or
granted before the promulgation of this Act shall be deemed to have been
validly imparted or granted under the said Act as if this Act were in force at
the time when such training or certifi cate was imparted or granted.
